pages.name: Overview
pages.html:
He arrives without summons. He examines without consent. He takes, and what remains is not the patient. The lower wards have begun to call him the Smiling Man.

V.C. Lenore, Torch & Clarion

A Scalpel in the Dark

Dr. Pemberton's shadow tracks a Pale Journal page to a reading-society gathering. Under the darkness resulting from a dragon raid, it cuts the host's skull, takes the page-knowledge, and leaves the body to rise as a Mythos grotesquery carrying what was stolen.

Episode Summary
Players 3–6, Level 6
Duration ~4 hours
Pacing Invistigation;
Scenes 4
Actors The Host; The Clarion Agent; The Shadow; The Grotesquery
Reward One page of the Pale Journals; Mr. Johanson's calling card
References Curse System; Dread Insight; Mythos stat blocks; residential maps

Timeline

Fifteen years ago. A private collector arranged for The Pale Journals to be stolen from the Temple of Anhur in Sai Abbadon.

Two years ago. Imperial Zeshagu stormed out of the mountain fortresses and joined forces with Sous Terreborgue. Sai Abbadon fell before winter. The continent burns.

One year ago. The dragons of Zeshagu closed the skies over Anchester. Sous Terreborgue warships sealed the harbors. The city was besieged. Fast boats and faster airships run the blockade; everything and everyone else stays inside the walls. The collector commissions the Pale Journals be copied. Imperfect pages are shared outside the collection.

Four months ago. Dr. Aldous Pemberton attends a reading of one such page above a tobacconist on Lantern Avenue. He is changed by the event and his shadow begins hunting.

Two months ago. The first body is found in the lower wards. Skull missing above the eyebrows. Five more follow within three weeks. The Torch & Clarion prints stories that spark the public interest. The Watch does not name a suspect. The lower wards name him themselves. The Smiling Man.

This week. A page of the Pale Journals reaches the host's collection through an acquaintance. The host issues tonight's invitations the following morning. The shadow knows.

Tonight. The page will be read.

pages.name: Shape of Play
pages.html:
1. The Reading, in which the players meet the host and several guests, and have the run of the house to explore and catalog what may be of use later.

2. The Raid, in which the Dragons of Zeshagu attack, blasting the buildings around the house with dragonfire and putting the lights out.

3. The Shadow, in which Dr. Pemberton's shadow slips in unseen, removes a piece of the host's brain, and leaves a Spawn in his place.

4. The Grotesquery, in which the players help the Clarion Agent attempt to capture the Spawn, but the Agent is mortally wounded and the thing escapes.
"You must stop it before it can infect the city with the knowledge it stole." Clarion Agent 5. The Hunt, in which the players chase the grotesquery into the rubble. They fight it again, bigger, before it runs away.

6. The Hunted, in which the players find that they have become the hunted.

[it] came in low over North Harbor and I saw the green again. Verdigris on the underside of the throat, the same as Brasshold in the spring. The same as Ash Ward in the summer. The lower wards call it the Green Menace.

          --Westin Garnhem, Torch & Clarion

pages.name: Cast
pages.html:
Claude Skohle

Antiquarian, mid-fifties, widower.

AC10; HP6; Dagger+1/1d4-1; History+5, Insight+3 Description: Slight, balding, ink-stained fingers, mourning band on his sleeve.

Mannerisms: Speaks in hushed cadence. Pauses mid-sentence to listen, as if for something the rest of the room cannot hear.

Intent: Wants to read the page before learned company and confirm its authenticity. Sleeps poorly since acquiring it.

Professor Adlard Hollow

University historian, late sixties.

AC10; HP4; Walking stick+0/1d4-1; History+7, Investigation+5, Arcana+3 Description: Tall, gaunt, half-moon spectacles. Spotted hands.

Mannerisms: Speaks in long sentences with subordinate clauses. Polishes his spectacles before answering any question he has not prepared for. Intent: Wants to authenticate the page and publish first. Has tracked the Anhur theft for fifteen years.

Father Mercer Penance

Priest of the Martyr, late forties.

AC12; HP9; No weapon; Religion+5, Insight+5, Persuasion+3

Description: Black cassock worn at the cuffs. Plain wooden cross. Tired eyes.

Mannerisms: Speaks softly. Crosses himself twice before any difficult subject.

Intent: Wants to learn what the page says so he can decide whether to report it to his bishop. Has been quietly researching a doctrinal heresy he believes the page may concern.

Miss Constance Sharp

Rationalist journalist, thirty-four.

AC11; HP9; Hatpin+1/1d4; Investigation+5, Insight+5, Persuasion+3

Description: Plain dress, deliberate. Notebook in her hand. Sharp jaw, level gaze.

Mannerisms: Writes during conversations. Repeats a speaker's own words back at them as questions.

Intent: Wants to embarrass at least two people in this room and file the piece by Friday. Came to debunk.

Madame Vellora Sigh

Society medium, age uncertain.

AC10; HP4; No weapon; Performance+5, Insight+5, Religion+3

Description: Beaded shawl, painted brows, perfume that lingers. Wears more rings than fingers.

Mannerisms: Trails off mid-sentence as if listening. Closes her eyes when others speak. Breathes audibly.

Intent: Wants to feel the page in the room and be seen feeling it. Will claim credit for any phenomenon tonight regardless of cause.

Sir Reginald Stowe

Collector, early forties.

AC11; HP9; Sword cane+3/1d6+1; History+3, Persuasion+5, Insight+3 Description: Industrial fortune, new title. Sharp dress, oiled hair, heavy signet ring. Mannerisms: Voice carries even when he means to whisper. Stands too close in conversation. Touches the cuff of whoever he is negotiating with. Turns the signet ring when impatient.

Intent: Wants to buy the page before the reading and resents Skohle for refusing. Will offer twice what the page is worth.

Major Lyle Wakes

Wounded veteran, late thirties.

AC14 (leather); HP32; Revolver+5/2d6+3, two attacks; Investigation+5, Perception+5, Stealth+3, Insight+3

Description: Walking stick, slight limp. Reserved bearing.

Mannerisms: Watches the room. Speaks rarely. Stands with his back to a wall. Does not drink what is offered.

Intent: A Clarion Agent under cover. Wants to assess the page, the gathering, and the threat. Reveals as Clarion when the Spawn manifests. Will fight to give the players time and the page to Mr. Johanson before dying.

pages.name: Horrors
pages.html:
The Shadow of Dr. Aldous Pemberton

Mythos creature; see Bestiary. Description: A man-shaped absence. No features visible except, when it turns, the face: bowler hat, round spectacles weeping blue, a smile.

Mannerisms: Slips through walls and under doors. Moves in interrupted intervals, as if seen by lightning.

Intent: Wants the knowledge in Skohle's brain. Will not engage the players unless cornered. Flashes its face at one player on its way out.

Author's Note

This is a horror episode. Not an adventure. The dragons are the surface threat. What enters the dark is the real one. The war is wallpaper. The structure is built around three moments where information is withheld asymmetrically. The face-flash is one player's secret. The shadow's purpose is the Keeper's secret. The grotesquery's hunger threshold is the system's secret. Each one rewards Keepers who let the players decide how to feel instead of closing it with exposition. The Stalker hits hard against level four, by design. The party that brings it down will spend resources they cannot easily replace and walk away with curses they cannot easily shed. The party that does not bring it down learns that the city now holds something it did not hold yesterday. Either way, the only leads they have are the agent's card and the page they carry.
